defs.def: the things that you wear, such as trousers/pants, dresses and jackets 衣服；服装

ex.s: Wear clothes that can get dirty.
ex.t: 请穿不怕弄脏的衣服。

ex.s: Wear proper clothes.
ex.t: 穿合适的衣服。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

ex.s: Most of them wore clothes that were torn and dirty.
ex.t: 大多数人穿着破旧脏污的衣服。

ex.s: It's the best way to get rid of your used clothes, score clothes from your friends, and have a party all at the same time.
ex.t: 这是处理你旧衣服、从朋友那儿淘衣服、同时开个派对的最佳方式。

ex.s: A successful swap depends on the selection of clothes, the organization of the event, and, obviously, how much fun is had.
ex.t: 一次成功的交换取决于衣服的选择、活动的组织，当然还有玩得有多开心。

ex.s: They should also prepare plenty of reusable bags to carry their "new" clothes home.
ex.t: 他们还应该准备大量可重复使用的袋子，把"新"衣服运回家。

ex.s: One of the ground rules of the swap should be that everyone must try on the clothes before they take them—things always look different when you put them on.
ex.t: 衣物交换的基本规则之一应该是：每个人在拿走衣服之前必须试穿——衣服穿在身上看起来总是不一样的。

ex.s: Donate whatever clothes are left over
ex.t: G 告诉每个人带干净且状况良好的衣服

ex.s: Have everyone put their clothes in the right spots
ex.t: 让每个人把衣服放到正确的位置

ex.s: G Tell everyone to bring clean clothes in good condition
ex.t: G 告诉每个人带上状况良好的干净衣服

ex.s: The woman looked at him in confusion and said something about changing her clothes.
ex.t: 女人困惑地看着他，说了些关于换衣服的话。

ex.s: Unusual fashion shows in New Orleans and Brooklyn have(showcased)nutria fur made into clothes in different styles.
ex.t: 新奥尔良（ New Orleans ）和布鲁克林（ Brooklyn ）不寻常的时装秀（展示）了制作成不同风格服装的营养皮草。

ex.s: SILENCE in big black letters was on signs hung everywhere If she thought you were dressed improperly, she sent you straight back home to change your clothes.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的"安静"标志到处都是如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: Performance： A dramatic presentation of the topic no more than 10 minutes long． If special clothes are used， they should truly represent a given period．
ex.t: 表演：对该主题进行的戏剧性展示，时长不超过10分钟。若使用了特殊服装，应真实代表某个特定时期。

ex.s: special clothes and a screen
ex.t: A．特殊服装和屏幕

ex.s: a projector and special clothes
ex.t: C．投影仪和特殊服装

ex.s: （1分）My washing machine                 this week， so I have to wash my clothes by hand．（  ）
ex.t: 14．（1分）只有当车停在我们房子前面时，我们才看到莉莉坐在乘客座位上。（ ）

ex.s: Wear warm clothes.
ex.t: 穿暖和的衣服。

ex.s: If you want time to have breakfast with your family, save some time the night before by setting out clothes, shoes, and bags.
ex.t: 如果你想有时间和家人一起吃早餐，前一天晚上就把衣服、鞋子和包准备好来节省时间。

ex.s: So if moving the body can have these effects, what about the clothes we wear?
ex.t: 所以，如果移动身体能有这些效果，那我们穿的衣服呢？

ex.s: Indeed, they made only half as many errors as those wearing their own clothes on the Stroop Test( one way of measuring attention).
ex.t: 事实上，他们在斯特鲁普测试（一种测量注意力的方法）中犯的错误只有穿自己衣服者的一半。

ex.s: The researchers call the effect “enclothed cognition,” suggesting that all manner of different clothes probably affect our cognition in many different ways.
ex.t: 研究人员称之为“着装认知”效应，认为各种各样不同的衣服可能以许多不同的方式影响我们的认知。

ex.s: People doing different jobs should wear different clothes
ex.t: 从事不同工作的人应该穿不同的衣服

ex.s: Wash her clothes.
ex.t: C．洗她的衣服。

ex.s: Somehow I couldn’t do it myself, so I went around and got a plain clothes man to do the job.
ex.t: 在亚洲文化中，笑容可以遮掩脆弱的情绪，避免让别人为自己担心。

ex.s: Not only do they provide us with food, clothes and oxygen to breathe, but they also make our surroundings more beautiful.
ex.t: 它们不仅为我们提供食物、衣物和呼吸所需的氧气，还使我们周围的环境更加美丽。

ex.s: I no longer felt the weight of my clothes, or of my shoes, of my air supply, or my thick helmet, inside which my head shook like a nut in its shell.
ex.t: 我不再感受到衣服的重量，或鞋子的，或供氧设备，或厚头盔的——我的头在里面摇得像坚果壳里的核仁。

ex.s: All we had left were the clothes on our backs.
ex.t: 我们只剩下背上的衣服了。
